100% Brazilian Remy human hair featuring a beautiful Level 6 root that melts into dimensional blonde highlights and lighter blonde ends.

The deeper root creates a natural, lived in look while the brighter face framing pieces and blonde throughout add contrast, depth, and gorgeous dimension. The long layers and soft waves give her a full, polished finish with plenty of movement.

Because this is 100% human hair, treat and style her just like your natural hair. She arrives professionally colored and styled, but shipping may affect the finished look, so you may want to restyle her to your preference after unboxing.
